subject: gunblade
pitch:
Category: Weapon.
Subject: gunblade.
Style: Final Fantasy.

requests.what: Add a vertical chain of three engraved arcane runes on the clear front face of the blade, alternating CYAN and MAGENTA. Use thin angular glyphs with a faint dark outline and tiny silver studs at their corners.
Build a dramatic serrated spine fitting along the model's left edge of the blade: five dark steel teeth with small GOLD collars, following the blade's upward angle without covering the broad face.
Add a glowing CYAN energy aperture inside the front muzzle, surrounded by a stepped MAGENTA warning ring and four tiny gold retaining bolts.
Add a visible six-spoke brass revolver chamber on the front side of the receiver, with a dark central axle, six small SILVER cartridge sockets, and a thin CYAN indicator arc.
Add two rows of large gold hex bolts and small black inset screws along the receiver's side plates, keeping the main dark receiver silhouette visible.
Build a stylized trigger assembly inside the guard: a curved GOLD trigger, a dark hinge pin, and a tiny MAGENTA safety switch on the receiver underside.
Set a large faceted ruby-red crystal into the center of the crossguard, with a dark outline bezel and two small gold claw prongs.
Add a premium leather wrap over the grip in alternating LEATHER and GOLD bands, with diagonal stitching, a cyan tassel-like power cord exiting from the lower right, and a small pommel-side clasp.
Add a small suspended CYAN materia crystal beneath the pommel, held by three gold prongs and a short dark chain. Keep its lowest point just above the floor.
Add thin gold filigree rails over both swept guard wings, ending in small dark steel arrowhead caps and a pair of tiny magenta signal lights.

Paint the broad blade face with brushed SILVER and STEEL facets, a restrained blue reflection along the fuller, hairline scratches near the edge, and a faded Final Fantasy-style serial mark near the upper rear.
Paint the receiver in charcoal and NAVY panel blocks with warm wear on corners, subtle diagonal machining lines, tiny gold caution marks, and a faded unit number near the rear.
Paint the grip as deep brown leather with alternating darker wrap bands, tiny cream stitch marks, and soft worn highlights on the front-facing ridges.
Paint the guard with polished GOLD on its upper planes, bronze shadow planes beneath, and a repeating angular engraved motif that leads toward the center jewel.
